lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਸੰਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t sa(n)g kaahoo nahee deenaa birathaa aap ba(n)dhaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: In the end, nothing shall go along with you; you have entrapped yourself in vain. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਓ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਨਹ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa har bhajio na gur jan sevio nah upajio kachh giaanaa ||
lines.translation: You have not meditated or vibrated upon the Lord; you have not served the Guru, or His humble servants; spiritual wisdom has not welled up within you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਤੈ ਖੋਜਤ ਉਦਿਆਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ghat hee maahi nira(n)jan terai tai khojat udiaanaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Lord is within your heart, and yet you search for Him in the wilderness. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮਤ ਤੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahut janam bharamat tai haario asathir mat nahee paaee ||
lines.translation: You have wandered through many many births; you are exhausted but have still not found a way out of this endless cycle.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਇ ਪਦ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: maanas deh paai pad har bhaj naanak baat bataaee ||3||3||
lines.translation: Now that you have obtained this human body, meditate on the Lord's Feet; Nanak advises with this advice. ||3||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re prabh kee saran bichaaro ||
lines.translation: O mind, contemplate the Sanctuary of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਨਕਾ ਸੀ ਉਧਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih simarat ganakaa see udharee taa ko jas ur dhaaro ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Ganika the prostitute was saved; enshrine His Praises within your heart. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਭਇਓ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: atal bhaio dhroo jaa kai simaran ar nirabhai pad paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Dhroo became immortal, and obtained the state of fearlessness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dukh harataa ih bidh ko suaamee tai kaahe bisaraaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord and Master removes suffering in this way - why have you forgotten Him? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਜ ਗਰਾਹ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab hee saran gahee kirapaa nidh gaj garaah te chhootaa ||
lines.translation: As soon as the elephant took to the protective Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of mercy, he escaped from the crocodile.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਮਾ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਬਰਨਉ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਹ ਤੂਟਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mahamaa naam kahaa lau baranau raam kahat ba(n)dhan tih tootaa ||2||
lines.translation: How much can I describe the Glorious Praises of the Naam? Whoever chants the Lord's Name, his bonds are broken. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ajaamal paapee jag jaane nimakh maahi nisataaraa ||
lines.translation: Ajaamal, known throughout the world as a sinner, was redeemed in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਚੇਤ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਤੈ ਭੀ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat chet chi(n)taaman tai bhee utarahi paaraa ||3||4||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, remember the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires, and you too shall be carried across and saved. ||3||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: praanee kaun upaau karai ||
lines.translation: What efforts should the mortal make,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa te bhagat raam kee paavai jam ko traas harai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: to attain devotional worship of the Lord, and eradicate the fear of death? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਰਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun karam bidiaa kahu kaisee dharam kaun phun karaee ||
lines.translation: Which actions, what sort of knowledge, and what religion - what Dharma should one practice?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਉ ਤਰਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaun naam gur jaa kai simarai bhav saagar kau taraee ||1||
lines.translation: What Name of the Guru should one remember in meditation, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਪੈ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal mai ek naam kirapaa nidh jaahi japai gat paavai ||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the One Lord is the treasure of mercy; chanting it, one obtains salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਰ ਧਰਮ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਮ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aur dharam taa kai sam naahan ih bidh bed bataavai ||2||
lines.translation: No other religion is comparable to this; so speak the Vedas. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਹਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh dukh rahat sadaa niralepee jaa kau kahat gusaaee ||
lines.translation: He is beyond pain and pleasure, forever unattached; He is called the Lord of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਪਨਿ ਨਿਆਈ ॥੩॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: so tum hee mahi basai nira(n)tar naanak darapan niaaee ||3||5||
lines.translation: He dwells deep within your inner self, O Nanak, like the image in a mirror. ||3||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮੈ ਕਿਹਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਲਖਉ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee mai kihi bidh lakhau gusaaee ||
lines.translation: O mother, how can I see the Lord of the world?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਿਮਰਿ ਮੋ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਉਰਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa moh agiaan timar mo man rahio urajhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the utter darkness of emotional attachment and spiritual ignorance, my mind remains entangled. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮ ਹੀ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਇਓ ਨਹ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal janam bharam hee bharam khoio nah asathir mat paaee ||
lines.translation: Deluded by doubt, I have wasted my whole life; I have not obtained a stable intellect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆਸਕਤ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀ ਅਧਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bikhiaasakat rahio nis baasur nah chhootee adhamaaee ||1||
lines.translation: I remain under the influence of corrupting sins, night and day, and I have not renounced wickedness. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ ਨਹ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g kabahoo nahee keenaa nah keerat prabh gaaee ||
lines.translation: I never joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and I did not sing the Kirtan of God's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਗੁਨੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak mai naahi kooo gun raakh lehu saranaaee ||2||6||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, I have no virtues at all; keep me in Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਬਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee man mero bas naahi ||
lines.translation: O mother, my mind is out of control.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਤ ਕਿਹਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੋਕਉ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nis baasur bikhian kau dhaavat kihi bidh rokau taahi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Night and day, it runs after sin and corruption. How can I restrain it? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕੇ ਮਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹੀਏ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed puraan simrit ke mat sun nimakh na heee basaavai ||
lines.translation: He listens to the teachings of the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, but he does not enshrine them in his heart, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਿਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: par dhan par daaraa siu rachio birathaa janam siraavai ||1||
lines.translation: Engrossed in the wealth and women of others, his life passes away uselessly. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਭਇਓ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਸੂਝਤ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mad maaiaa kai bhaio baavaro soojhat nah kachh giaanaa ||
lines.translation: He has gone insane with the wine of Maya, and does not understand even a bit of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸਤ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ghat hee bheetar basat nira(n)jan taa ko maram na jaanaa ||2||
lines.translation: Deep within his heart, the Immaculate Lord dwells, but he does not know this secret. ||2||
